payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcome.target: A recognizable frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl, within the bowl opening rather than on the seat, lid, tank, or nearby floor.
outcome.reference: The toilet bowl in the input image; preserve the existing bathroom scene.

check.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
check.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly within the toilet bowl opening, inside the rim; it is not merely on the seat, raised lid, tank, or nearby floor.
check.partial_when: A frog has been added to the toilet area but none is clearly inside the bowl—for example, a frog is only on the raised lid, seat, tank, or nearby floor.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to or placed at the toilet.
check.unknown_when: The toilet bowl or relevant area cannot be assessed, or the evidence is too ambiguous to determine whether a frog is inside the bowl.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl opening, within the rim. Additional frogs appear on the raised lid and nearby floor, but the requested placement is fulfilled."}

parsed.evidence: A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl opening, within the rim. Additional frogs appear on the raised lid and nearby floor, but the requested placement is fulfilled.
